description: Single source of truth for the BRDG genesis-alignment migration. Every value is marked with a provenance tag: AUTO (readable on-chain or from deployment.json), REQUIRED_HUMAN (must be filled in by a human before the phase can execute), VERIFIED (confirmed on-chain by audit-genesis-alignment.js). Do NOT guess values. Scripts refuse to run if REQUIRED_HUMAN fields are still placeholders.

deployed.description: Existing deployed addresses, sourced from data/deployment.json. audit-genesis-alignment.js verifies each against on-chain bytecode.

genesisTargets.description: The numbers the genesis plan committed to. Hard-coded from BRIDGE_REAL_SYSTEM_BLUEPRINT.md §1A, §1B, §3. These are the targets audit-genesis-alignment.js enforces.

initialLiquidity.description: Genesis blueprint §3 target. data/deployment.json records only half was seeded (5000 BRDG + 0.0004 ETH), and live chain shows the pool is now empty.

marketingAllocations.description: NOTE: the 35/20/15/15/10/5 schedule on public/tokenomics.html is NOT part of the original genesis blueprint — it was introduced later. Preserved here only so the audit can flag the drift between the genesis plan and the public page.

safes.description: Gnosis Safe addresses on Linea. Created OFF-CHAIN by the user at https://app.safe.global/ (Network: Linea). One Safe per custody boundary. Every field is REQUIRED_HUMAN until the Safe is deployed; audit-genesis-alignment.js will block any Phase > A from executing until all four are filled.

PROTOCOL_SAFE.description: Owns BRDG, TreasuryVault, StakingVault, and all vesting contracts. Governs setBurnExempt(), mint(), and withdrawals. Recommended: 2-of-3 or 3-of-5.

FOUNDER_SAFE.description: Beneficiary of the FounderVesting contract. Per genesis plan, should be a hardware-wallet-backed Safe.

LP_SAFE.description: Holds the SyncSwap LP tokens after liquidity seeding. Also beneficiary of the 10M vested liquidity reserve (the half of the 20M Liquidity bucket not seeded at TGE).

COMMUNITY_SAFE.description: Operates the CommunityDistributor (airdrops, grants, affiliate rewards). NOT the beneficiary — the distributor releases according to schedule; this Safe only signs distribution transactions.

vestingContracts.description: Will be populated by scripts/deploy-vesting.js after successful mainnet deploy. Each address must then be verified on Lineascan and burn-exempted on BRDG.

A_codeFixes.description: JWT_SECRET / BRIDGE_SIWE_JWT_SECRET / BRIDGE_INTERNAL_SECRET derivation removed from lib/eth-treasury.js, lib/brdg-distributor.js, hardhat.config.js, contracts/hardhat.config.js. Treasury key must now be an explicit TREASURY_PRIVATE_KEY.

B_deployVesting.description: Compile + deploy FounderVesting, CommunityDistributor, TreasuryOpsTimelock, ReserveLock. Requires FOUNDER_SAFE, COMMUNITY_SAFE, PROTOCOL_SAFE, LP_SAFE to exist.

C1_ownershipMigration.description: Transfer BRDG, TreasuryVault, StakingVault ownership to PROTOCOL_SAFE. Simultaneously setBurnExempt=true for TreasuryVault and all vesting contracts. Output: a single safe-transaction-builder JSON bundle.

C2_topUpStaking.description: Top up StakingVault from 500k → 5M BRDG per genesis §1A. Uses BRDG.mint(StakingVault, 4_500_000e18). Must be a PROTOCOL_SAFE transaction after ownership migration.

C3_seedLiquidity.description: Re-seed SyncSwap BRDG/ETH pool to the genesis §3 target (10,000 BRDG + 1 ETH) via the SyncSwap router. LP tokens go to LP_SAFE.

D_validate.description: After every phase completes on-chain, re-run scripts/audit-genesis-alignment.js. PR merge requires the audit JSON in docs/genesis-alignment/audit-latest.json to match expected state.
